_rules: A style is a treatment of the render, never the word being drawn: it says how the picture is made (camera, material, medium, world), how it is lit, which colours it uses and what sits behind.

No object noun klein could draw instead of the sketch (no 'toy', 'figurine', 'sign', 'vase', 'plush'). A style may name a WORLD the drawing is read in (product design, brutalist building, game asset, sprouts on moss, fossil): that is Krea's trick and it is allowed, because the world is not the word.
The more concrete the look, the better klein follows it: name the exact material, finish, tool marks and lens. 'colorful' or 'nice' say nothing to it.

Each style has: look (imperative, how it is rendered), light, palette (named colours), backdrop (plain phrase without 'background'), tags (CLIP tags for StreamDiffusion, most important first, no object nouns).
The subject comes only from the sketch, the hint word or the live guess; the fidelity sentence comes from AI Strength (src/lib/prompt.ts).

styles.label: Natural
styles.look: Photograph it with a real camera in natural daylight, true-to-life materials and textures, 50 mm lens, slight depth of field
styles.palette: true-to-life colors
styles.tags: photorealistic, natural daylight, 50mm, true-to-life colors, sharp detail

styles.label: Producto
styles.look: Render it as an HD photorealistic render of a high-end physical product design: clean industrial-design surfaces, matte anodised aluminium, soft-touch polymer and brushed steel details, precise seams, chamfers and parting lines, hero three-quarter view
styles.light: a large softbox with a smooth gradient and a soft contact shadow
styles.palette: warm grey, graphite, bone white and one brushed-steel accent
styles.backdrop: a seamless warm grey studio sweep
styles.tags: photorealistic product design render, industrial design, anodised aluminium, brushed steel, soft-touch polymer, studio softbox

styles.palette: fresh lime green, deep moss green and dark loam
styles.backdrop: a bed of damp moss with blurred ferns
styles.tags: 4k nature macro photo, living green sprouts, leaves, damp moss, dew drops, overcast forest light

styles.label: Low poly

styles.palette: clean matte sage, sand, terracotta and slate, one flat colour per facet
styles.backdrop: a plain mid-grey studio floor with a soft contact shadow
styles.tags: polished low poly 3d render, hard-edged facets, flat shading, studio hdri lighting, ambient occlusion, game art
